Changes what the Manager sees (nudge text), so QA blackbox checks it. AC: log lines, 5/15 min nudges, opt-in sleep, tests for touched files. Dev model: sonnet high.

scopes.name: task-claim-gates
scopes.brief: Task claim, blocking and gates by hook. The squad board (bin/squadboard_tasks.py, squadboard_active.py and related) shows many tasks as 'no activity recorded', owner 'unassigned' and stage 'todo' / 'in progress' / 'checking' although the tasks are already implemented and passed. Evidence: Chieu's screenshot of the board Tasks panel for squad plugin, scope lean-config (tickets .scratch/process-fixes/issues/01..11): 01, 02, 07, 09 show todo; 03, 08, 11 show in progress; 05, 06 show checking, 1 of 1 PASS; owner unassigned or the Developer; last active empty. Goal: the task claim, completed and update states must be recorded correctly (by hook, not by hand), so the board stage, owner and last active match reality, and gates (a task cannot be claimed while blocked, cannot be done without every checker's PASS) are enforced by hook. Work together with the session e1d015d2-53b6-445e-ba74-07ef67b96a48 (an idle Claude session in /home/chieule/workspace/squad, pane w5T:p1; ask Chieu what it knows or message it by session id before you design). First move: use the mattpocock-skills:grill-me skill (or mattpocock-skills:grilling) to grill Chieu on anything unclear, in the inbox, before you propose team and plan. Do not change the squad board design that Chieu confirmed (memory: squad-board design, Mango Parrot light palette).
